notes.title: Regista - Day 1 Patch
notes.content:
Thank you for the interest that you have shown in Regista! 



With your comments and feedback, you have been delivering through Steam Discussions, Discord and social media, we are delivering a better experience of Regista. We will consistently continue to develop Regista with you, Managers.



Below, you can find the changelog for this day 1 patch.



Changelog

Fixed an issue with follow-up cards overlapping.

Aftermatch event cards will always appear in the first card after the match.

Fixed an issue where a preset tactic is forced back to 4-3-3 after every match.

Fixed a couple of content issues on the cards.

notes.title: Regista Steam Next Fest Update
notes.content:
The Next Fest Update Patch Notes
Hello everyone!

Today, we're excited to roll out a major update packed with new features and improvements to our demo. Let's dive into the patch notes!

This update introduces a deeper level of strategy and management, along with a host of other enhancements to enrich your experience.
Introducing the Morale System
We're taking player management to a whole new level. Every player on your squad now has a morale level that directly impacts their performance on the pitch. Your decisions as a manager will have a direct impact on their performances. A happy and motivated squad will push for those crucial wins, while a demoralized team might crumble under pressure and perform poorly. Choose your actions wisely; the fate of your club hangs in the balance.
Preset Tactics System: Your Strategy, Your Way
To give you more control over your team's on-field strategy, we've implemented a brand-new Preset Tactics System. You can now define your strongest lineups and tactical approaches for Defensive (5-4-1), Balanced (4-4-2), and Offensive (4-3-3) playstyles. In the future, you will have the option to make your own unique formation.
A World of New Content
The world of Regista is now richer and more dynamic than ever before:

All Encounters Updated: We've reviewed and refreshed all in-game encounters to provide more varied and interesting challenges.

New Characters and Event Types: Get ready to meet new personalities and navigate unexpected situations with a range of new event types.

Expanded Match Texts: We've added more variety to the in-match commentary to bring the action to life.
Polishing the Experience
We're committed to delivering a polished and enjoyable experience for all players:

Localization Updates: We've updated our localization in all supported languages to ensure a clearer and more immersive experience for our global community.

Added New SFX and VFX: Enjoy a more vibrant and responsive game with the addition of new sound effects and visual flourishes.

Improved Tutorial: We've refined the tutorial to provide a smoother and more informative introduction for new players.
And for a Little Fun...
For those moments when you need a quick break from the pressures of management, we've added a couple of fun mini-games to the ESC Menu:

Reflex Time Test: Test your reaction speed!

Ball Bounce: A simple, classic distraction.

We're incredibly excited for you to get your hands on this updated demo during the Steam Next Fest. Your feedback will be invaluable as we continue to develop and refine Regista: Reign Your Football Club. So jump in, start your managerial career, and let us know what you think!

Thank you for your continued support!
